_about: Hand-checked against mgymrek/lobstr-code at 47da4cac554952f14a78bb4230d39efa1eaf8b0b (tag v4.0.6) on 2026-09-29, from README (one line pointing to http://lobstr.teamerlich.org/), HACKING.md, configure.ac, models/, scripts/lobstr_index.py, scripts/GetSTRInfo.py, src/main_allelotype.cpp, and the lobSTR website as archived by the Wayback Machine in August 2016 (usage, install, download, best-practices-wgs-wes, best-practices-bwamem, best-practices-custom-reference, ystr-codis, best-practices-ystr-codis, faq): lobstr.teamerlich.org and files.teamerlich.org no longer resolve (NXDOMAIN). Also the v4.0.6 GitHub release and api.anaconda.org.

install.documented: Precompiled Linux x86_64 binary tarball (the download page links lobSTR-bin-Linux-x86_64-4.0.6.tar.gz on the GitHub release; copy bin/lobSTR, bin/allelotype, bin/lobSTRIndex onto PATH), or from source: ./configure; make; make check; sudo make install (a git checkout needs ./reconf first); Homebrew (brew tap homebrew/science; brew install lobstr) on macOS.

published.where: https://web.archive.org/web/20160831103349id_/http://lobstr.teamerlich.org/download.html:38,43; https://github.com/mgymrek/lobstr-code/releases/tag/v4.0.6 (lobSTR-bin-Linux-x86_64-4.0.6.tar.gz, lobSTR-4.0.6.tar.gz); https://api.anaconda.org/package/bioconda/lobstr (not found; no lobSTR package in any Bioconda search)

extra_inputs.what: lobSTR index for the reference (--index-prefix; a BWA index of STR regions plus flanks). Published only as hg19 and GRCh37 resource bundles on files.teamerlich.org, which no longer resolves; any other build (hg38) must be made with scripts/lobstr_index.py --str <STR table> --ref <fasta> --out <dir> from a Tandem-Repeats-Finder-style table of >=15 columns (1-5 chrom/start/end/period/copies, 9 score, 15 motif), with bedtools and pyfasta installed.
STR info file (--strinfo), from the same resource bundle or generated with scripts/GetSTRInfo.py str_bed_file ref_genome.fa > strinfo.tab (a Python 2 script).
Noise model prefix (--noise_model), shipped with lobSTR as models/illumina_v3.pcrfree.stepmodel and .stuttermodel (installed to $PREFIX/share/lobSTR/models).

runnable_on_strhub_data.why: allelotype (and the lobSTR aligner before it) needs a lobSTR index and the matching STR info file. The documented ones are the hg19/GRCh37 resource bundles on files.teamerlich.org, which no longer resolves; the alternative is building a custom index from a Tandem-Repeats-Finder-style STR table (>=15 columns including score and motif). STRhub holds no lobSTR index and none of its region layouts (HipSTR, GangSTR, STRsearch, BED4) is that table.

notes: The repository README is one line pointing to http://lobstr.teamerlich.org/ (README:1). That site and files.teamerlich.org (which hosted the resource bundles and the install page's binary links) return NXDOMAIN on 2026-09-29, so every usage citation is to Wayback Machine captures of August 2016, two months after the v4.0.6 tag; the download page then listed 4.0.6 as current. The pipeline is lobSTR (align) -> samtools sort/index -> allelotype (genotype); the generic template on the same page is `allelotype --command [train|classify] --bam OUTPUT_PREFIX.sorted.bam --noise_model NOISEMODELPREFIX --out OUTPUT_PREFIX --strinfo STRINFOFILE --index-prefix PATH_TO_INDEX/lobSTR_` (usage.html:85-91). classify is the genotyping mode and --command is an option, not a subcommand; the options exist at the pinned commit (src/main_allelotype.cpp:195-227). The documented `samtools sort in.bam out_prefix` form is the legacy samtools syntax, which current samtools rejects (it wants -o). Since v4, allelotype also takes BWA-MEM BAMs (recommended extra flags --filter-mapq0 --filter-clipped --max-repeats-in-ends 3 --min-read-end-match 10, best-practices-bwamem.html:77-80); the STRhub BAM is novoalign-aligned, not a documented aligner, so a faithful run realigns its reads with lobSTR (`-f my_sample.bam --bampair` after `samtools sort -n`, best-practices-wgs-wes.html:109-121). The hg19 lobSTR reference includes the CODIS and Y-STR markers, and the site has a tutorial for typing them from WGS (ystr-codis.html, best-practices-ystr-codis.html). No Bioconda package exists under lobstr or lobstr-code. The install page's own links use files.teamerlich.org with X.X.X placeholders; the download page links the GitHub v4.0.6 assets, which still exist. Building from the git tree needs autotools (configure.ac, Makefile.am, ./reconf), boost, cppunit, gsl and zlib (HACKING.md:8-42). strhub_type is illumina-bam-hg38 because the documented inputs are Illumina WGS/WES reads (FASTQ/FASTA/BAM); the ForenSeq amplicon FASTQ is not a documented use.
